AHA (Alpha Hydroxy Acid): Flakes away dead skin cells on the surface to smooth rough texture.
BHA (Beta Hydroxy Acid): Dissolves deep-seated sebum and oil inside pores to clear blackheads and prevent breakouts.
PHA (Poly Hydroxy Acid): Gently lifts away impurities while locking in moisture, minimizing irritation.

Adenosine: Supports skin barrier repair and improves overall skin elasticity.
